两两合并n次。两两求前n个的方式是n路归并，即a[0]+b[i],a[1]+b[.en: Merge the sequences pairwise n times. To find the n smallest pair sums, use a multiway merge: the m streams a[0]+b[i], a[1]+b[i],..., a[m-1]+b[i] compete for the smallest value. Put the first item of each stream in a priority queue; whenever an item is removed, insert the next item from that stream. With heapq, use heapq.heappop() to remove the minimum; a plain pop() removes the last list element.

Almost every day since arriving at university, the daily optional problems have stayed on my Chrome to-do list. Most times I open my laptop, one or more unfinished problems are waiting in their tabs. Sometimes I think slowly; sometimes I am too eager for results. I do not always do as well as I would like, but learning a new algorithm still draws me in, and every Accepted verdict makes me genuinely happy. I often feel I am not yet good enough as an AI student. Even if I use vibe coding for other work, I insist on solving every algorithm problem by hand, and I still prefer algorithm courses—an OI contestant at heart, even in college. Of course, I used to feel even less adequate as an OI contestant. But the past matters less now. Doing something tiring yet useful and enjoyable is a good way to spend my time. So I try to enjoy this moment: alone, anywhere, opening my laptop onto a whole world.

安卓版不再只是连接电脑服务器的窗口。它内置运行环境、客户端资源与同一份服务端逻辑.zh: 安卓版不再只是连接电脑服务器的窗口。它内置运行环境、客户端资源与同一份服务端逻辑，安装 APK 后可以新建进度，或从系统文件选择器导入备份，再独立进入游戏。
安卓版不再只是连接电脑服务器的窗口。它内置运行环境、客户端资源与同一份服务端逻辑.en: The Android version is no longer just a window connected to a server on a computer. It bundles the runtime, client assets, and the same server-side logic. After installing the APK, players can start a new save or import a backup through the system file picker, then play independently on the device.

The Android shell serves local assets, opens the file picker, and saves files. Windows, Android, and the web continue to share one gameplay implementation, reducing inconsistencies between platforms.

iPhone / iPad 采用 PWA：在 Safari 打开对应版本，添加到.zh: iPhone / iPad 采用 PWA：在 Safari 打开对应版本，添加到主屏幕，再从桌面图标进入、导入存档并下载完整离线资源。资源缓存完成后可以断网运行。它不是 IPA，也不需要把 Python 服务器放到网站上；网站只提供静态程序与资源，游戏和存档仍在使用者自己的设备中运行。
iPhone / iPad 采用 PWA：在 Safari 打开对应版本，添加到.en: On iPhone and iPad, the game uses a PWA: open the appropriate edition in Safari, add it to the Home Screen, then launch it from that icon to import a save and download all offline resources. Once caching is complete, it can run without a connection. This is not an IPA and does not require hosting a Python server; the website serves only static programs and assets, while gameplay and saves remain on the user's device.

导入导出，保存对应版本的完整离线状态，包括日记和已经保存的照片图层。同时支持兼容.zh: 导入导出，保存对应版本的完整离线状态，包括日记和已经保存的照片图层。同时支持兼容的 JSON 状态文件，以及包含完整登录初始化数据的协议 JSONL。
导入导出，保存对应版本的完整离线状态，包括日记和已经保存的照片图层。同时支持兼容.en: for import and export, preserving the edition's complete offline state, including the diary and saved photo layers. Compatible JSON state files and protocol JSONL files containing complete login initialization data are also supported.

普通版和图鉴版仍严格分开。不同玩家在自己的设备上保存自己的进度，不使用作者的个人.zh: 普通版和图鉴版仍严格分开。不同玩家在自己的设备上保存自己的进度，不使用作者的个人存档，也没有共用的云端账号。每个版本目前只有一个活动存档；同一台电脑上的不同玩家可以分别解压到不同目录，手机或网页切换进度则先导出、再导入，不会自动同步。
普通版和图鉴版仍严格分开。不同玩家在自己的设备上保存自己的进度，不使用作者的个人.en: The Standard and Gallery editions remain strictly separate. Each player keeps their own progress on their own device; neither the author's personal save nor a shared cloud account is used. Each edition currently has one active save. Players sharing a computer can extract separate copies into different folders. On phones or the web, export before importing another save; there is no automatic synchronization.

中找到它；安卓和网页增加“导出上次导入前的备份”，让玩家不需要 root 或访问.en: ; Android and the web provide an "Export backup from before the last import" option, so players can recover the overwritten save without root access or opening the app's private storage.

官服账号密码本身不是存档。官服备份仍需要先保存完整初始化数据，并额外加载相册详情.zh: 官服账号密码本身不是存档。官服备份仍需要先保存完整初始化数据，并额外加载相册详情；只有照片索引不能保证还原历史构图。介绍页把开启采集日志、浏览各模块、解析数据、导入普通版及恢复原脚本的过程整理成独立教程。
官服账号密码本身不是存档。官服备份仍需要先保存完整初始化数据，并额外加载相册详情.en: An official-server username and password are not a save file. Backing up official progress still requires capturing the full initialization data and loading album details separately; photo indexes alone cannot guarantee reconstruction of the original compositions. The project page provides a separate guide to enabling capture logs, browsing each module, parsing the data, importing it into the Standard Edition, and restoring the original script.

这一轮检查重点从“页面能打开”，进一步延伸到“操作之后会不会保存、更新程序会不会.zh: 这一轮检查重点从“页面能打开”，进一步延伸到“操作之后会不会保存、更新程序会不会丢进度”：
这一轮检查重点从“页面能打开”，进一步延伸到“操作之后会不会保存、更新程序会不会.en: This review went beyond whether a page opens to whether actions are saved and whether updates preserve progress:

：从游戏返回起始页会重新读取名字与进度，不再显示改名前的旧信息；导入前的备份可以.zh: ：从游戏返回起始页会重新读取名字与进度，不再显示改名前的旧信息；导入前的备份可以直接导出恢复。
：从游戏返回起始页会重新读取名字与进度，不再显示改名前的旧信息；导入前的备份可以.en: : returning from the game to the start screen reloads the name and progress, rather than showing stale information from before a rename. Pre-import backups can be exported directly for recovery.

：联网时优先检查 HTML、JS、配置和 Python 程序包的新版本，断网时使.zh: ：联网时优先检查 HTML、JS、配置和 Python 程序包的新版本，断网时使用已保存的缓存；不需要为了更新代码而清理网站数据。
：联网时优先检查 HTML、JS、配置和 Python 程序包的新版本，断网时使.en: : when online, the app checks for updated HTML, JavaScript, configuration, and Python packages first; offline, it uses the saved cache. Updating the code does not require clearing website data.

：电脑从长时间休眠恢复时，给浏览器重新发送心跳的时间；导出进度期间也不会停止后续.zh: ：电脑从长时间休眠恢复时，给浏览器重新发送心跳的时间；导出进度期间也不会停止后续的关闭监测。
：电脑从长时间休眠恢复时，给浏览器重新发送心跳的时间；导出进度期间也不会停止后续.en: : after a long sleep, the browser is given time to resume sending heartbeats. Exporting progress no longer disables subsequent shutdown monitoring.

：取消或写入失败时会向游戏返回失败结果，结束本次保存操作，不留下持续等待的界面状.zh: ：取消或写入失败时会向游戏返回失败结果，结束本次保存操作，不留下持续等待的界面状态。
：取消或写入失败时会向游戏返回失败结果，结束本次保存操作，不留下持续等待的界面状.en: : cancellation or a write failure is reported back to the game, ending the save operation instead of leaving the interface waiting indefinitely.

Chromium 和 WebKit 中分别验证了新建进度、进入游戏、改名、返回管.zh: Chromium 和 WebKit 中分别验证了新建进度、进入游戏、改名、返回管理页、导出、覆盖导入、取回旧进度以及完整缓存后断网重载。Windows 与安卓模拟器也验证了进入庭院和升级保留进度。实体安卓手机与 iPhone 的安装、长期离线、系统回收存储等行为仍留给实机验收，不能用浏览器自动测试代替所有机型的结果。
Chromium 和 WebKit 中分别验证了新建进度、进入游戏、改名、返回管.en: Chromium and WebKit were each used to verify new saves, entering the game, renaming, returning to save management, exporting, importing over an existing save, recovering old progress, and reloading offline after a complete cache download. Entering the courtyard and retaining progress across upgrades were also verified on Windows and in an Android emulator. Installation, extended offline use, and OS storage reclamation on physical Android phones and iPhones still require real-device acceptance testing; automated browser tests cannot stand in for every device.

源码与安装包分开管理：源码仓库保留独立编写的服务、补丁工具和文档；完整测试程序作.en: Source code and installation packages are managed separately. The source repository contains independently written services, patching tools, and documentation; complete test builds are kept as release attachments. Personal saves, raw network captures, and the entire local working directory are not committed.

The introduction page and Studio game entry are not being published yet. Newly added asset commits from this round have also been removed from the public homepage branch, without changing existing posts or uncommitted edits. The release tool uploads drafts by default; publication still requires real-device acceptance testing and explicit confirmation.

Later visits from the same province award ordinary gifts according to the official configuration. Provincial flowers are a collection associated with visits. After a frog leaves, its gift stays until claimed; repeated clicks neither duplicate the reward nor allow the next visitor to overwrite it.

Repeated logins do not reroll the schedule, restarting does not replace a frog that is eating, and a long absence does not accumulate a courtyard full of visitors. The intervals and randomized stays are local design choices, not claims about a confirmed official-server algorithm.

The main capacity/strategy comparison uses dependency-preserving replay: input and output token counts are fixed and tool intervals are recorded, while service time can shift later request start times and task interleaving; makespan (time to finish the whole batch) includes these intervals. These results do not prove higher task success rates, and the hardware and trajectory coverage remain limited.

编排器标出系统提示、用户查询、工具结果、最终回答和部分 prefill 等类别，.zh: 编排器标出系统提示、用户查询、工具结果、最终回答和部分 prefill 等类别，引擎结合类别设置驱逐优先级，同级使用 LRU。本文策略优先回收最终回答、再到工具输出与用户查询，较晚回收系统提示，优先保护等待续接的部分 prefill。最终回答低复用是本文工作流的假设；多轮聊天中它可能进入下一轮历史，不能直接照搬固定排序。调度同时保留整个 Agent 请求的到达顺序。
编排器标出系统提示、用户查询、工具结果、最终回答和部分 prefill 等类别，.en: The orchestrator marks categories such as system prompts, user queries, tool results, final answers, and partial prefill; the engine assigns eviction priorities by category and uses LRU within the same priority. This paper's policy reclaims final answers first, then tool outputs and user queries, keeps system prompts longer, and preferentially protects partial prefill waiting to be continued. 编码 Agent 压缩历史后，仓库里的修改还在，但此前排除过的假设、测试约束和下.en: After a coding Agent compresses its history, the repository changes remain, but previously ruled-out hypotheses, test constraints, and next-step plans may be lost. Starting from the same history and the same repository snapshot, the paper gives the same continuation Agent the full history or only a summary, and compares whether subsequent repairs can pass the tests. This design fixes the work completed before compression, reducing interference from the natural differences between two full trajectories.

评测分三部分：配对续跑测任务保留；用后续交互中再次出现的细节测摘要覆盖；在记录下.en: Evaluation has three parts: paired continuation measures task retention; details that reappear in later interactions measure summary coverage; and recorded production sessions track whether details survive multiple rounds of compression. The three metrics answer, respectively, "can the repair continue," "is the specific information retained," and "is it still visible after multiple compressions."

在 35 个 SWE-bench 修复中，作者以完整历史可通过的 22 个任务计.zh: 在 35 个 SWE-bench 修复中，作者以完整历史可通过的 22 个任务计算损伤率。固定 Claude Code 摘要提示与 Kimi-K3 续跑模型时，14 个摘要模型的稳定损伤率为 5%–64%；有的任务跨多种摘要方法仍容易失败。固定 Kimi-K3 比较摘要提示时，保留更多字面细节的提示与保留最多修复结果的提示不同。结果受仓库任务、模型和预算限制；字面重复不等于语义保留，生产链观察也不能直接证明修复失败。
在 35 个 SWE-bench 修复中，作者以完整历史可通过的 22 个任务计.en: Among 35 SWE-bench repairs, the authors computed the damage rate on the 22 tasks that the full history could pass. With the Claude Code summarization prompt and the Kimi-K3 continuation model fixed, the stable damage rate across 14 summarization models ranged from 5% to 64%; some tasks remained failure-prone across multiple summarization methods. With Kimi-K3 fixed to compare summarization prompts, the prompt that preserved more literal detail differed from the one that preserved the most repair outcomes. The results are limited by the repository tasks, models, and budget; literal repetition does not equal semantic retention, and production-chain observations cannot directly prove that a repair failed.

用配对续跑设计比较压缩策略时，可以同时记录修复通过、摘要生成开销和压缩后首轮新增.zh: 用配对续跑设计比较压缩策略时，可以同时记录修复通过、摘要生成开销和压缩后首轮新增 prefill。这样能把“保住任务进度”和“省下推理计算”放到同一次干预中比较；本文主要提供前者的测量设计。
用配对续跑设计比较压缩策略时，可以同时记录修复通过、摘要生成开销和压缩后首轮新增.en: When comparing compression strategies with a paired-continuation design, one can record repair pass rates, summarization overhead, and the additional prefill in the first round after compression together. This places "preserving task progress" and "saving inference compute" in the same intervention for comparison; this paper mainly provides the measurement design for the former.

Choose Load unpacked and select the fold.zh: 点击“加载已解压的扩展程序”，选择含 manifest.json 的目录。Edge 如提示修改新标签页，请选择“保留更改”。
Choose Load unpacked and select the fold.en: Choose Load unpacked and select the folder containing manifest.json. In Edge, keep the new-tab change if prompted.

Open a new tab. After updating the local.zh: 打开新标签页即可体验。更新本地文件后，在扩展卡片上点击“重新加载”。
Open a new tab. After updating the local.en: Open a new tab. After updating the local files, use Reload on the extension card.

Download firefox.zip from Releases when.zh: 发布后，从 Releases 下载 firefox.zip，或使用自行构建的文件。
Download firefox.zip from Releases when.en: Download firefox.zip from Releases when available, or use your local build.

Open the debugging page below, choose Lo.zh: 打开下方调试页面，点击“临时载入附加组件”，选择 firefox.zip 或解压目录中的 manifest.json。
Open the debugging page below, choose Lo.en: Open the debugging page below, choose Load Temporary Add-on, then select firefox.zip or the extracted manifest.json.

Open a new tab. Temporary add-ons must b.zh: 打开新标签页即可体验。临时扩展在 Firefox 重启后需要重新加载；长期安装需要 Mozilla 签名。
Open a new tab. Temporary add-ons must b.en: Open a new tab. Temporary add-ons must be loaded again after restarting Firefox; permanent installation requires Mozilla signing.

In the project folder, install dependenc.zh: 在项目目录安装依赖并构建浏览器安装包。
In the project folder, install dependenc.en: In the project folder, install dependencies and build the browser packages.

Output: builds/chrome_edge.zip and build.zh: 构建生成 builds/chrome_edge.zip 与 builds/firefox.zip。也可加载解压目录 builds/build_chrome 或 builds/build_firefox。
Output: builds/chrome_edge.zip and build.en: Output: builds/chrome_edge.zip and builds/firefox.zip. For unpacked loading, use builds/build_chrome or builds/build_firefox.

Open the gear menu, then Personalization.zh: 打开齿轮菜单中的“个性化”，搜索诗句、作者或篇名，也可以选择推荐名句。选回“随机诗句”即可恢复轮换。
Open the gear menu, then Personalization.en: Open the gear menu, then Personalization. Search for a verse, author, or title, or choose a recommended poem. Select Random poem to resume rotation.

In Background, choose waves or Blobs, a.zh: 在“背景”中选择波浪或 Blobs、昼夜主题与动静设置。在“个性化”中选择传统色，或自定义波浪底色与名称。选回“随机”即可恢复颜色轮换。
In Background, choose waves or Blobs, a.en: In Background, choose waves or Blobs, a theme, and motion settings. In Personalization, choose a traditional color or customize the wave color and its name. Choose Random to restore color rotation.

In Fonts, choose a bundled font and char.zh: 在“字体”中选择内置字体与字形，分别调整诗句和色名的字号。女书凤栖可附带汉字原文；缺少女书字形的字会以汉字显示。
In Fonts, choose a bundled font and char.en: In Fonts, choose a bundled font and character style, then adjust poem and color-name sizes separately. Nüshu Fengqi can show the Chinese original alongside; characters without a matching glyph fall back to Chinese.

In Settings, turn on Show favorite websi.zh: 在“设置”中开启“显示常用网址”，最多可添加 8 个地址。悬停或聚焦卡片后，通过菜单编辑或移除。网址保存在当前浏览器，关闭后重新开启会恢复。
In Settings, turn on Show favorite websi.en: In Settings, turn on Show favorite websites. Add up to eight addresses; hover or focus a card and use its menu to edit or remove it. Favorites are stored in the current browser and return when re-enabled.

Change colors in wave mode.zh: 在波浪背景下切换颜色

Dark waves and vertical Chinese poetry.en: Dark waves and vertical Chinese poetry

Poetry with a colorful Blobs background.zh: 彩色 Blobs 背景上的诗句
Poetry with a colorful Blobs background.en: Poetry with a colorful Blobs background

Poem and color history, pinned choices,.zh: 诗句与颜色历史、固定选择和常用网址保存在当前浏览器，不会自动跨浏览器或设备同步。
Poem and color history, pinned choices,.en: Poem and color history, pinned choices, and favorite websites stay in the current browser. Do not assume they will automatically sync across browsers or devices.

Thanks to the original Jizhi contributor.en: Thanks to the original Jizhi contributors and the maintainers of the poetry, color, and font resources. Full credits and data sources are documented in the repository.

An unofficial enhancement of Jizhi, a Ch.en: An unofficial enhancement of Jizhi, a Chinese-poetry new-tab extension with traditional-color animations, offline poems, and customizable fonts. Currently in development.

Based on the original Jizhi extension by.en: Based on the original Jizhi extension by Unicar and its contributors. Features include offline poems, animated wave and Blobs backgrounds, poem search and pinning, and bundled fonts including Nüshu Fengqi.

Offline Chinese poetry with search and p.en: Offline Chinese poetry with search and pinning

A Windows focus and study planner with c.en: A Windows focus and study planner with customizable app restrictions, task and planning lists, and offline focus history.

FocusBloom brings timers, task lists, an.zh: 一刻专注把计时、待办和课表放在一起。严格模式下，可以自行选择限制哪些 Windows 应用。核心功能无需联网或注册。
FocusBloom brings timers, task lists, an.en: FocusBloom brings timers, task lists, and a class calendar together. In Strict Mode, you can choose which Windows apps to restrict. Core features work offline without an account.
